title: fleet.yml
description: Per-repo declaration for the fleet standard: tier, visibility, documented exceptions and the secret inventory. See STANDARD.md.

tier.description: Repo class from docs/inventory.md. Sets which CI stages run (ci-contract.md, section 4).

visibility.description: GitHub visibility. The governance variant follows from it: public -> public, private -> private-free. Changing it is the deliberate step that goes with a visibility flip (GOV-ENV-08).

visibility_decision.description: Why a private repo stays private or goes public (CI-COST-18).

exceptions.description: Documented deviations. An exception replaces the value of one rule; the rule is still evaluated.

secrets.description: Inventory of static secrets (SEC-07). Names and metadata only, never a value.

rule.description: Rule ID, for example CI-COST-12. The rule must exist and allow exceptions.

value.description: The value that replaces the rule's default. Its shape is set per rule (value_schema in rules/*.yml).

reason.description: One sentence: why this repo differs.

expires.description: Date the exception ends (at most 12 months ahead). Required for CI-COST-* rules.

minutes_per_month.description: Estimated Actions minutes per month this exception costs. Required for CI-COST-* rules in private repos.

scope.description: Where the secret lives: repo (Actions), dependabot, or env:<environment>.

expires.description: Date the secret must be rotated (at most 365 days ahead).
